title: Action Configurations
description: Configuration schemas for all automation actions

colorTolerance.description: Mean CIE76 deltaE a match may differ from its reference image by. Template matching runs on grayscale, so without this a recoloured copy of the image matches perfectly. Defaults to 50 for web actions, which absorbs the font, sub-pixel and compression differences between the machine a reference was captured on and the one replaying it. Lower it to catch subtler colour changes; 0 disables the check, matching the image in any colour.

outputVariable.description: Variable to store response

responsePath.description: Optional path into the response to store in the output variable, e.g. data.token, headers["Content-Type"], data.items[0].id. Applied to the response object {status_code, headers, data, url} (body fields under data.). When empty, the full response object is stored.

expectedStatus.description: Explicit expected HTTP status code(s). When set, the call fails unless the response status is one of these; overrides the default 2xx check that validateStatus performs.

assertions.description: Response assertions evaluated after the request. All must pass for the action to succeed.

ApiCallConfig.description: Make an HTTP API request. Set responsePath to store only a path of the response (e.g. data.token) in the output variable; leave empty to store the full {status_code, headers, data, url} object. Use validateStatus/expectedStatus and assertions to turn the call into a network/response check.

target.description: What to assert on: HTTP status, a response header, a JSONPath into the parsed body, the raw body text, or the total response time in ms.

path.description: For target=jsonPath, the path into the response body (e.g. data.items[0].id). For target=header, the header name (case-insensitive).

operator.description: Comparison operator. exists/notExists ignore value; matches treats value as a regular expression; in expects value to be a list.

value.description: Comparison value. Its type depends on the operator and target (string, number, or list).

ResponseAssertion.description: A single assertion applied to an HTTP response.

action.description: apply: install block/throttle/header rules for the session; clear: remove them; captureHar: read the current session's network log into a variable.

blockUrls.description: URL patterns to block (Chrome Network.setBlockedURLs wildcards, e.g. *.analytics.com/*).

throttleDownloadKbps.description: Download throughput in kbps when throttle=custom.

throttleUploadKbps.description: Upload throughput in kbps when throttle=custom.

throttleLatencyMs.description: Added latency in milliseconds when throttle=custom.

extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers injected into every request for the session.

userAgent.description: Override the User-Agent for the session.

harOutputVariable.description: Variable to store the captured HAR-like network log when action=captureHar.

NetworkControlConfig.description: Control the browser's network layer via Chrome DevTools: block hosts, throttle bandwidth, inject headers/User-Agent, or capture the network log. Chromium only.

standard.description: WCAG conformance level (axe-core tag) to audit against.

includeSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to restrict the audit to a region of the page.

failOnSeverity.description: Fail the action when a violation of this impact or higher is found; 'none' never fails.

outputVariable.description: Variable to store the list of violations.

AccessibilityAuditConfig.description: Run an axe-core accessibility audit on the current page and report WCAG violations. Chromium recommended.

outputVariable.description: Variable to store the captured metrics object.

budgets.description: Optional per-metric budgets in milliseconds/score (e.g. { "lcp": 2500, "cls": 0.1 }); the action fails if any captured metric exceeds its budget.

CaptureWebVitalsConfig.description: Capture Core Web Vitals and navigation timing (LCP, FCP, CLS, TTFB, load) from the current page via the Performance APIs.

baselineName.description: Identifier for the baseline image. Defaults to the step label/id when empty.

threshold.description: Minimum SSIM similarity (0-1) required to pass; below this the step fails on visual drift.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page (Chromium) instead of just the viewport.

updateBaseline.description: Approve the current page as the new baseline (overwrites the stored baseline).

diffOutputVariable.description: Variable to store the comparison result (score, threshold, diff image).

VisualRegressionConfig.description: Compare a full-page screenshot against a stored baseline using perceptual SSIM. First run (or updateBaseline) records the baseline; later runs fail on visual drift beyond the threshold.
